summary: watch dedup now strips the composite parent suffix from collections_items ids.
reason: Items synced via 'sync --resources collections_items' are stored under a composite key (id + NUL + collections_id), so ListIDs returns composite keys while live search returns bare f.ID. seen[f.ID] never matched, so every collections_items-synced scene was reported as new on every run. Added store.BareResourceID to strip the NUL-delimited suffix and applied it when building watch's seen set.
